title: Shinonome Ena — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It isn't time yet, but I wonder if anyone else is here...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Did you just get back from school?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Have you two already started working?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Actually, I just took a bath...
I was about to get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm also just coming back after stepping out for a bit for food.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <By the way, I got to have one of my all-time favorites for dinner! Curry! What was on the menu for the Shinonomes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It looks just the way it sounds.
You sandwich ground pork between a couple of slices of lotus root and fry them up.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I've never heard of that before...
But I'm sure Ms. Mochizuki has...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I bet!
Oh, Kanade, what did you have for dinner?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me? Umm... Meat and potato stew with bean sprout namul on the side.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, Honami's meat and potato stew's gotta be amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<It was incredibly delicious.
She also did a good job of not making it too rich.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's good to hear that you're eating right.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What was that? You're not her parent, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, I left my tea downstairs...
I'll be right back.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, by the way, Amia...
Did you go to school today?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh? Now who sounds like a parent?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I get it. Anyway, did you or did you not?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I went and wasn't late.
I even attended the opening ceremony. Aren't I a good student?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, true! Anyway, why are you asking?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No real reason. I just happened to see the new class rosters posted at school out in the corridor earlier.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, really? Did they forget to take them down or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, I got curious and decided to take a look. It said Akito and Shiraishi are in the same class with you and Toya in another.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right! This might sound weird coming from me, but they're pretty interesting combinations, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Akito and Shiraishi already know each other pretty well, but what do you and Toya have to talk about?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Well, there's music...
We could also start recommending books, anime and other stuff that we like to each other.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Toya's a great listener, so I sorta can't help but go on and on about those kinds of things.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Really? Then, I'm glad you're classmates now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, Toya's pretty impressionable, so don't teach him anything weird, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha! Don't worry, I won't.
Li'l Bro would get super mad at me, and I just wanna be friends with Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sounds like they've been getting along just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
It's nice to hear that Mizuki has someone to talk to in class.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, K, are you there? Welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm back. I'll be putting myself on mute so that I can work straight until 25:00.>
